idea-plugin.name: FIX Decoder
idea-plugin.description:
Reads FIX protocol messages where they are written: in Java string literals, text blocks and concatenations, and in plain text files.

  • Hover over a field to see the tag name, type, what the value means (54=1 is Buy), the other allowed values, and whether the message type requires it
  • Decode a message into a table in the FIX Decoder tool window, with repeating groups as numbered instances. Click a value to select it in the editor, even inside a concatenation
  • Repeating groups are checked: counts against the instances found, the first field of each instance, field order, and unknown tags that end a group early
  • Wrong BodyLength (9) and CheckSum (10) are reported, and a quick fix recomputes them, keeping the string's escapes (\u0001 or \001)
  • Inline hints show value meanings next to the values
  • Convert delimiters between SOH and |, copy a message as readable text, and choose how to paste a message from a log into Java code
  • Custom dictionaries (QuickFIX/J XML) for venue-specific tags and values

Bundles the FIX 4.2, FIX 4.4, FIX 5.0 SP2 and FIXT 1.1 dictionaries. Settings are in Settings | Tools | FIX Decoder.

This product includes software developed by quickfixengine.org (http://www.quickfixengine.org/): the bundled data dictionaries come from QuickFIX/J and are used under the QuickFIX Software License.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1-beta

  • Search in the decoder table (Ctrl+F): highlights matching tags, names, values and meanings; Enter and the arrow keys jump between matches
  • Flat list view of the decoded message, without nested repeating groups
  • Settings button in the decoder toolbar; inline hints are now off by default
  • Hover in Java uses IntelliJ's own documentation popup, so it no longer shows "No documentation found" on top
  • Alt+Enter: Decode FIX message
  • Custom dictionaries: a redefined component (such as Parties) now applies to every message that uses it, a custom header adds to the standard one, and custom enum values are added to the standard ones
  • Repeating groups: a tag that isn't defined for the group stays in its instance instead of ending the group; custom message types (35=U...) pick the group layout that fits
  • Fixes: an error when marking files with problems in 2026.1 and later, and an empty row at the top of the table

1.0.0-beta: first release, for early feedback.
